summary: A trader lost about 150000 dollars after buying the hype driven SCAM Altman meme token near peak market cap following Elon Musk related social media buzz then selling after a rapid 95 percent collapse. The token showed classic speculative pump behavior with insider distribution signals and no product or fundamentals
user_mistake: bought hype driven token near peak without due diligence
prevention: Avoid buying viral meme tokens after rapid pump / Review token fundamentals and holder concentration before entry
